description: This file contains Python code defining classes and functions for testing and analyzing Zephyr test suites, including regex-based parsing of test source files, and managing test case and test suite data structures.

classes.name: ScanPathResult
classes.description: Class representing the result of scanning a test source file, including test matches, warnings, and detected test structures.

classes.name: TestCase
classes.description: Class representing an individual test case, including its name, status, output, and associated test suite.

classes.name: TestSuite
classes.description: Class representing a collection of test cases, with methods for loading data, adding subcases, and generating unique identifiers.

methods.name: scan_file
methods.description: Parses a source file to identify test suites, test cases, and test main function presence using regex patterns.

methods.name: scan_testsuite_path
methods.description: Scans a directory for C/C++ source files and aggregates test case information and test suite names.

methods.name: find_c_files_in
methods.description: Finds C and C++ source files within a specified directory and its subdirectories.

methods.name: get_unique
methods.description: Generates a unique name for a test suite based on its directory and name.

methods.name: check_suite_name
methods.description: Validates the format of a test suite name.
